content: माणवकः .²1 A youth, boy, lad, youngster (<ab>oft.</ab> used contemptuously). .²2 A little man, dwarf; manikin; मायामाणवकं हरिम् <ls>Bhāg. 8. 18. 24</ls>. .²3 A silly fellow. .²4 A scholar, religious student. .²5 A pearl-necklace of sixteen (or twenty or forty-eight) strings; ग्रीवाद्भुतैवावटुशोभितापि प्रसाधिता माणवकेन सेयम् <ls>N. 7. 66</ls>. .{@-कम्@} A kind of metre.
